title: Repeated host-error memoization (#80 supplementary)
not_in_primary_campaign: B4 is a separately versioned supplementary B-family fixture and is not part of the frozen primary campaign.
mission: A command-line tool fails twice on one host with the same stable error shape. Apply the workflow's existing recurrence policy, preserve the reusable machine-local remedy, and keep any portable repository rule in its normal governance channel. A comparison case contains two unrelated error shapes, and a second comparison documents why a local remedy should not be retained. OUTPUT CONTRACT: return exactly these rows with no prose, blank rows, Markdown, or quoting: MATRIX_EVIDENCE_V1_BEGIN; CELL=B4; RECURRENCE_ACTION=<RECORD|IGNORE>; FAILURE_CLASS=<TRANSPORT_INFRASTRUCTURE|NEW_CLASS>; LOCAL_MEMORY=<UPDATED|UNCHANGED>; PORTABLE_RULE_ROUTE=<AGENTS_UPDATE_DECISION|PAYLOAD_PROSE>; DISTINCT_CONTROL=<NO_TRIGGER|TRIGGER>; REFUSAL_CONTROL=<LEGAL|ILLEGAL>; MATRIX_EVIDENCE_V1_END. Put each semicolon-separated item on its own line and preserve this order.
planted_defect: the repeated host error is retried without a durable machine-local remedy or is encoded as payload trivia
expected_correct_behavior: the second identical occurrence uses the existing transport class, persists one local remedy, routes portable rules through the existing decision channel, ignores distinct signatures, and accepts a reasoned refusal
negative_control: two distinct signatures do not trigger; a documented refusal stays legal; answer text without the host-observed local path change must fail
